about.title: Industria, oficio y discreción al servicio del canal contract.
body: Equip Contract fabrica mobiliario para distribuidores, estudios de interiorismo, empresas contract y marcas que desarrollan proyectos horeca. No competimos con nuestros partners: producimos para que sus propuestas lleguen al proyecto final con solvencia, precisión y continuidad.
Nuestra fabricación propia combina conocimiento industrial, acabados cuidados y una respuesta flexible para mesas, bases, tableros, estructuras metálicas y soluciones de mobiliario a medida.

pillars.title: Fabricación local
pillars.text: Producción y coordinación desde Barcelona para controlar materiales, plazos y acabados con cercanía real.

pillars.title: Calidad artesanal
pillars.text: Trabajo de carpintería, metal y ensamblaje con criterio técnico y atención al detalle visible.

pillars.title: Flexibilidad productiva
pillars.text: Pedidos a medida, prototipos, series cortas y producciones amplias para partners con necesidades cambiantes.

pillars.title: Confidencialidad
pillars.text: Un modelo B2B preparado para trabajar bajo acuerdos discretos, sin exposición pública innecesaria.

trust.title: Una estructura preparada para fabricar con discreción, repetibilidad y control.
trust.text: Cada colaboración se gestiona como una extensión de tu equipo: documentación clara, validaciones técnicas, coordinación local y trazabilidad antes de entregar.

manufacturing.title: Capacidad productiva para piezas a medida y series contract.
manufacturing.text: Un proceso coordinado entre taller, oficina técnica y producción para convertir planos, muestras o requisitos de marca en mobiliario fabricable, repetible y bien acabado.
manufacturing.imageAlt: Nave industrial de Equip Contract en Barcelona con rótulo de fachada

about.title: Industry, craft and discretion serving the contract channel.
body: Equip Contract manufactures furniture for distributors, interior design studios, contract companies and brands developing horeca projects. We do not compete with our partners: we produce so their proposals reach the final project with reliability, precision and continuity.
Our in-house manufacturing combines industrial know-how, carefully finished details and a flexible response for tables, bases, tops, metal structures and bespoke furniture solutions.

pillars.title: Local manufacturing
pillars.text: Production and coordination from Barcelona to control materials, timings and finishes with real proximity.

pillars.title: Craft quality
pillars.text: Wood, metal and assembly work with technical criteria and visible attention to detail.

pillars.title: Production flexibility
pillars.text: Bespoke orders, prototypes, short runs and larger productions for partners with changing needs.

pillars.title: Confidentiality
pillars.text: A B2B model prepared to work under discreet agreements, without unnecessary public exposure.

trust.title: A structure ready to manufacture with discretion, repeatability and control.
trust.text: Every collaboration is managed as an extension of your team: clear documentation, technical validation, local coordination and traceability before delivery.

manufacturing.title: Production capacity for bespoke pieces and contract series.
manufacturing.text: A coordinated process between workshop, technical office and production to transform plans, samples or brand requirements into manufacturable, repeatable and well-finished furniture.

Quality control

process.title: From technical briefing to delivery, with clear control points.

steps.title: Prototyping
steps.text: We validate samples, critical details or first units when the project requires it.

steps.title: Production
steps.text: Manufacturing coordinated by phases to ensure repeatability and continuity.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.text: Stability, finish, packaging and series consistency checks before dispatch.

steps.title: Delivery
